Two scorable themes (China Tech & Internet, China Platform Megacaps) are ineligible, providing a risk-control anchor.

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: This theme is scorable (3033.HK) and ranks 4th in momentum, but it fails the absolute trend gate (eligible=false). Given the gate's validated role in reducing drawdowns, avoiding ineligible themes is a risk-control lean.
theses.dissent: The trend gate may lag and the theme could be bottoming; false negatives are possible if the trend turns quickly. China tech could benefit if AI hardware narrative broadens out.

falsifier.text: If China Tech & Internet regains eligibility (gate flips true) AND its momentum score rises into the top 3, the underweight thesis is wrong.

theses.subject: China Platform Megacaps
theses.thesis: Scorable (3033.HK), rank 11 with negative momentum score, ineligible by trend gate. Aligns with risk-control logic to avoid non-eligible themes in a market where the gate helps.
theses.dissent: Megacaps may be oversold and could stage a sharp bounce if policy support emerges; the trend gate could be slow to recognize a V-reversal.

falsifier.text: If this theme’s eligibility turns true and its momentum score turns positive (rank improves), the underweight is invalidated.

theses.subject: Tech Hardware & Semis
theses.thesis: This is the sole dominant theme in a one-narrative market, it passes the trend gate (eligible), durability is moderate at 0.67, and it is not crowded. The overweight is a directional lean aligning with trend-following discipline, not a size call.
